content.title: Confirm tremor measurement runtime, bandwidth, sampling, and wearable constraints before component selection
content.description: Validate the minimum runtime, required tremor frequency range (measurement bandwidth), intended sampling rate, and wearable form-factor/calibration constraints so future embedded component selection remains grounded in user-confirmed needs.
content.rationale: The current functional architecture can capture unknowns as open questions, but selecting concrete measurement, timing, buffering, and export strategies requires confirmed measurement targets and wearable constraints.

completionCondition.completionCriteria: Confirm (1) minimum wearable tremor measurement runtime, (2) required tremor frequency range (measurement bandwidth), (3) intended sampling rate, and (4) wearable form-factor limits and calibration approach; then mark Q1-Q4 as answered/resolved and proceed to component selection in the next workflow.
